author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Inspected 48px and 384px in light and dark: a diagonal rocket with a wide body, a pointed curved nose cone marked by a seam, two swept-back fins and an exhaust streak, mirror-symmetric about its axis, as in the reference. A first candidate with a slim 8.5 body read as a dagger. The rejected drawing was a leaf-like outline with detached strokes.
omissions: The reference's fins are closed curved shapes; here they are open swept strokes (a closed fin this small has no open centre at 48px). The flame is one streak.
drawing_plan: Axis x+y=48: tail (13,25)-(23,35), sides to shoulders (25,13)/(35,23), nose cubics to (42,6), seam across the shoulders; fins from (16,22)/(26,32) to (6,20)/(28,42); exhaust (12,38)-(9,41).
lucide_reference: Lucide 'rocket': diagonal body, curved nose, swept fins.
